point: A when-question needs a time.
When 問句要回一個時間。
why: The question asks when the shuttle will begin running. Starting the first of next month gives a date, so it answers the question directly.
問題問接駁車什麼時候開始行駛。Starting the first of next month 給了日期，直接回答問題。

gloss.ex: The shuttle leaves every twenty minutes.
Please wait at the main entrance.

gloss.w: Starting the first of next month
gloss.ex: Starting Monday, the office opens at eight.

point: How much: the answer can be that the amount is not known yet.
How much：回答可以是金額還不知道。
why: The question asks how much the catering cost. Accounting hasn't sent us the bill yet means the amount is not known, so it is a fitting indirect answer.
問題問外燴總共多少錢。Accounting hasn't sent us the bill yet 表示金額還不知道，是合適的間接回答。

gloss.ex: The catering for the event was excellent.
The total comes to four hundred dollars.
The annual luncheon is held in June.

point: A why-question can be answered with a fact that implies the reason.
Why 問句可以用暗示理由的事實來回答。
why: The question says she chose to turn down the position, so the reason is something that keeps her here. Her whole family lives in this city gives that reason without saying because.
她回絕了職缺，所以理由是讓她留在這裡的事。Her whole family lives in this city 沒說 because，卻給了這個理由。

gloss.ex: She turned down the job offer.
He asked for a transfer to Chicago.
The form is on the intranet.

point: The reply reports the new time after a change.
回應報告改期後的新時間。
why: The question says now that it's been rescheduled. Nine o'clock, the same as before says nothing changed, so only It got pushed back to noon gives the new time.
問句說 now that it's been rescheduled。Nine o'clock, the same as before 表示沒有改，只有 It got pushed back to noon 給了新時間。

gloss.ex: We rescheduled the meeting for Friday.
I have a client call at three.
They pushed back the launch by a week.

point: A where-question can be answered by naming who knows.
Where 問句可以回答「誰知道」。
why: Nobody says where the samples are, but Ask at the front desk. Lena signed for them points to the person who received them. That is a helpful answer to Where.
沒人直接說樣品在哪，但 Ask at the front desk. Lena signed for them 指向收件的人，是對 Where 有用的回答。

gloss.ex: The courier delivered the package at noon.
She ordered fabric samples for the curtains.
Someone must sign for the delivery.
The firm imports tiles from Spain.

point: A how-question with a condition: use it to rule out one way.
帶條件的 how 問句：用條件刪掉一種方式。
why: The van is in the repair shop, so the answer must be another way. I've booked a rental truck names a different way to move the boards.
廂型車在修理廠，所以答案得是另一種方式。I've booked a rental truck 說出另一種運送方式。

gloss.ex: We set up the display boards early.
The expo center hosts three fairs a year.
My car is at the repair shop.
They hired a rental truck for the move.

point: A direct yes with a limit.
直接回 Yes，再補上限制。
why: The question asks if the café is open on weekends. Yes, but only on Saturdays says yes and adds the limit.
問題問咖啡廳週末有沒有開。Yes, but only on Saturdays 回答有，並補上限制。

gloss.ex: The lobby is on the ground floor.
The shop is closed on weekends.
They repainted the hallway last week.

point: A tag question: an excuse can mean no.
附加問句：說明原因也可以表示「沒有」。
why: The speaker expects a yes. Sorry, I thought Hana was handling that shows the booking was not done, so the answer is no.
說話者預期答案是有。Sorry, I thought Hana was handling that 表示沒訂，所以答案是沒有。

gloss.ex: We hired an interpreter for the meeting.
She booked a room for the workshop.
Who is handling the travel plans?

point: Compare two times: a later finish means no.
比較兩個時間：完成得比較晚就是沒趕上。
why: The crew was to finish before the clients arrive at noon. It'll take until after lunch is later than noon, so the answer is no.
維修人員要在客戶中午抵達前完成。It'll take until after lunch 比中午晚，所以答案是沒趕上。

gloss.ex: The maintenance crew arrives at six.
Please wait in the lobby.
The client was impressed by the results.

point: A condition can turn a yes into a partial yes.
條件可以把 Yes 縮小成部分的 Yes。
why: Finance has the room for the whole afternoon. Only in the morning says the room is free then, but not in the afternoon.
財務部整個下午都訂了會議室。Only in the morning 表示只有早上有空，下午沒有。

gloss.ex: I reserved the room for Monday.
The workshop takes the whole afternoon.
The bank employs forty analysts.

point: A negative question: a limit can mean no.
否定問句：說明做不到，答案就是 No。
why: The question suggests sea freight. Our warehouse partner only handles air freight means sea is not possible, so the answer is no.
問題提議海運。Our warehouse partner only handles air freight 表示海運行不通，所以答案是 No。

gloss.ex: The display units arrive on Tuesday.
We attend a trade show every spring.
Air freight is faster but costs more.

point: A tag question: a solution can mean yes.
附加問句：提到解決辦法可以表示 Yes。
why: The question asks if the speaker will still take the afternoon off. Ms. Kemp offered to cover for me solves the inspection problem, so the answer is yes.
問題問說話者是否照樣請下午假。Ms. Kemp offered to cover for me 解決了檢查的問題，所以答案是會。

gloss.ex: The inspection starts at nine.
I will take Friday off.
Can you cover for me on Friday?

point: Answer a statement by offering to check.
回應陳述句：說「我來查」。
why: The statement says the invoice is higher than the quote. Let me pull up the original estimate offers to compare the two, a natural next step.
陳述句說發票比報價高。Let me pull up the original estimate 表示要拿原本的估價來比對，是自然的下一步。

gloss.ex: Please send the invoice by Friday.
We asked three firms for a quote.
I'll pull up the file now.

point: Answer bad news with a question about the cause.
回應壞消息：追問原因。
why: The scores dropped, which is bad news. Was it the long waiting times again? asks about the cause, which fits the mood.
分數下滑是壞消息。Was it the long waiting times again? 追問原因，符合這個語氣。

gloss.ex: The survey takes five minutes.
Test scores improved this year.
Waiting times are longer on Mondays.

point: Answer a request directly: agree and add a detail.
回應請求：直接答應，再補一個細節。
why: The speaker asks to borrow a charger. Sure, it's in the top drawer agrees and says where to find it.
說話者想借充電器。Sure, it's in the top drawer 答應了，也說了東西在哪裡。

gloss.ex: Could you lend me a pen?
I left my charger at home.
All coats are on sale today.

point: Answer a choice question by checking one option.
回應選擇問句：去確認其中一個選項。
why: The studio seats only sixty, but over two hundred people have registered. I'll see if the main hall is free checks the only room big enough.
小棚只有六十個座位，但有兩百多人報名。I'll see if the main hall is free 是去確認唯一夠大的場地。

gloss.ex: The main hall seats five hundred.
The room seats about eighty people.
Forty people registered for the class.
Registration opens on Monday.

point: Answer a suggestion with a reason that means no.
回應建議：用理由表示不行。
why: The speaker suggests that two departments share the bill. Marketing has already used up its budget gives a reason why marketing cannot pay its half.
說話者建議兩個部門平分帳單。Marketing has already used up its budget 說明行銷部付不出那一半的原因。

gloss.ex: Let us split the cost evenly.
The bill came to ninety dollars.
We used up the whole budget.

point: Answer a choice question with a third option.
回應選擇問句：提出第三個選項。
why: The question offers the conference room or lunch. Let's just do it by phone this afternoon picks neither and offers a third way.
問題給了會議室或午餐兩個選項。Let's just do it by phone this afternoon 兩個都不選，提出第三種方式。

gloss.ex: We will go over the figures together.
The conference room is booked until noon.
We can settle this by phone.
